messages:
maya: Hey team — customer reports the onboarding gift link bounces with "invalid code" when they try to redeem. Code appears in email as GIFT-NEW-2026. They sent a screenshot.

leon: Can you paste the exact link they clicked?

maya: https://redwood.ai/redeem?code=GIFT-NEW-2026&utm_source=newsletter

sophie: Quick check — sometimes our frontend parsing breaks if there are extra query params. Can repro locally by clicking that full link. UI shows "Promo code invalid or expired".

leon: @ops_eli can you pull the backend request for that account? customer email: maya.cust+gift@example.com, error id from client (if available) was req_0x9a12.

ops_eli: Found it. Request req_0x9a12 -> POST /v1/promos/redeem body {"code":"GIFT-NEW-2026","email":"maya.cust+gift@example.com"} backend -> 404 {"error":"code_not_found","code":"GIFT-NEW-2026"}

ops_eli: Also seeing a mismatch: Promotion row exists in PromosDB but flagged inactive for eu-west-1 scope. Customer is in IE.

sophie: That aligns with my local repro. If the link includes utm param our client-side normalizer currently keeps the raw code but the server-side lookup is region-gated and the rollout didn't include EU due to a bad flag. RLW rollout queue shows a failed migration for that promo id.

maya: Customer explicitly expected 30 free credits for trial. They are in Ireland and pretty frustrated.

billing-jen: I'll issue a manual 30-credit grant to maya.cust+gift@example.com now and attach a note referencing this thread.

billing-jen: Manual credit applied: +30 credits. txn id manual_credit_2026_2067890123. Note: promo RLW_PROMO_2026 not applied because region tag missing for EU.

maya: Thanks, Jen. I'll let the customer know and apologize.

leon: Filing a bug for engineering: RLW-4592 — promo rollout gating ignored when link contains tracking params and promo not active in target region. Assigned to eng-runtime, severity P2.

sophie: Proposed mitigation: server-side strip of common utm params when parsing redeem links + add a fallback lookup that ignores region flag for known onboarding promos. Patch WIP, PR in review.

support-bot: Reminder queued: follow up with customer in 48h to confirm redemption pipeline fixed.

maya: I'll close once customer confirms they see credits or can redeem directly. :thumbsup:

leon: Note for postmortem: check rollout tooling that marks region active only after completion — migration hung due to an index timeout. Ops fixing index and will re-run rollout.

ops_eli: Confirmed: index rebuild scheduled, will re-run promo rollout in 1 hour.

maya: Great, thanks everyone.
